name: AI Document Intake Workflow
summary: Concept: extract document fields, check them, and route exceptions for review.
challenge: Business documents arrive in inconsistent formats and require careful checks before updating records.
approach: Proposed flow: ingest a sample document, extract text, ask a model for a constrained field set, validate required values using deterministic rules, and send uncertain results to a reviewer. This is a design concept using sample data.
features: Review queue for incomplete or ambiguous data
description: Illustrative workflow design concept using sample data. This is not a deployed product or client case study.
technologies: Proposed: Ollama, ASP.NET Core, C#, .NET 8 / .NET 9, Hangfire, SQL Server
